claims: Assess and manage anemia with hemoglobin 6.6 g/dL and hematocrit 20%, considering transfusion if clinically indicated.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and monitor oxygenation and ventilation.
Monitor and manage hypotension with mean arterial pressure 63 mmHg and systolic 87 mmHg.
Monitor lactate levels, which are elevated at 3.1 mmol/L and trending down to 1.6 mmol/L.
Monitor and manage coagulopathy with INR 1.6 and fibrinogen 182 mg/dL.
Continue sedation with propofol and dexmedetomidine to maintain Richmond-RAS goal of 0 to -2.
Monitor and manage pain with analgesics, targeting pain level 7.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin therapy as ordered.
Monitor and manage electrolyte abnormalities, including sodium 131-135 mEq/L and potassium 4.5 mEq/L.
Perform oral care with chlorhexidine rinse and subglottal suctioning to prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia.
